# Blue Hub

> AI agent tools for onchain builders and autonomous agents — analysis, audits,
> and signals over live reads on Base 8453 and Robinhood Chain 4663. Pay per
> call in USDC over the x402 protocol. No API key, no signup, no subscription.

Blue Hub exposes 115 tools: 109 paid and 6 free. Any x402-capable agent can call
a tool's endpoint directly and pay per request in USDC on Base (chain id 8453).
When a paid request arrives without payment, the endpoint returns HTTP 402 with
payment requirements; the agent signs an EIP-3009 authorization and retries with
an X-Payment header. Settlement is on-chain via the Coinbase CDP facilitator.

The 6 free tools are priced $0.00 in the catalog and never answer 402. Do not
build an authorization for them — there is nothing to sign and no transfer to
make. They are the safety checks and our own track record: blue-doctor,
hood-live, hood-track-record, pre-trade-check, rh-rwa-verify, rh-token-scan.

## Discovery
- Machine-readable catalog (all tools, endpoints, prices, input schemas): https://blueagent.dev/api/catalog
- MCP server (remote, no install): https://blueagent.dev/api/mcp
  Its manifest advertises 19 tools, a curated subset of the 115 tools above. The
  rest are not missing and not gated: call blue_registry to list the whole
  catalog, then blue_call to invoke any entry in it. The manifest is small on
  purpose, because an always-loaded tool list is context spent before the agent
  has read the question.
- Human UI: https://blueagent.dev/hub

## Payment
- Protocol: x402 (version 2)
- Network: eip155:8453 (Base mainnet)
- Asset: USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
- Endpoints: https://blueagent.dev/api/x402/{tool-id}  (POST)

## Examples
- Ecosystem digest: https://blueagent.dev/api/x402/ecosystem-digest
- Token pick signal: https://blueagent.dev/api/x402/token-pick-signal
- Market-fit validator: https://blueagent.dev/api/x402/market-fit

See https://blueagent.dev/api/catalog for the full list with prices and inputs.
